evaluation_items.title: Cross-workload non-monotonicity
evaluation_items.visual_question: Can adding statistics worsen target-workload CE loss?
evaluation_items.encoding: Two independent workload panels; use workload-local axes and never connect panels. Raw values remain labeled.
evaluation_items.caption: Statistics-set inclusion is empirically non-monotone in both frozen realizations. DMV aggregates q-error only over positive-truth queries; panels use independent axes and absolute loss is not compared across workloads.

evaluation_items.title: Census recurring ANALYZE cost
evaluation_items.visual_question: Does aggregate Census ANALYZE latency admit the first-order mechanism-aware approximation used by the final budget?
evaluation_items.encoding: One Census panel sourced directly from the frozen calibration CSV; distinct MCV and FD fits.
evaluation_items.caption: Aggregate Census ANALYZE latency supplies the first-order resource proxy used by the final budget. It is not a universal or candidate-specific PostgreSQL cost function.

evaluation_items.title: Native semantic fidelity within the supported fragment
evaluation_items.takeaway: Controlled, real-workload, and fresh-deployment comparisons all match native PostgreSQL at floating-point-scale relative error inside the supported boundary.

evaluation_items.title: Census maintenance-budget physical-design outcome
evaluation_items.takeaway: Replay selects a feasible mixed Census subset and provides audited fixed-precedence neighborhood-local rather than global optimality.

evaluation_items.title: Full-workload and exact incremental wall-clock results
evaluation_items.takeaway: Semantic incremental evaluation is exact and faster than full replay in every tested cell; full replay versus native CE is workload-dependent.

evaluation_items.title: Directed MCV-to-FD composition
evaluation_items.visual_question: Does MCV clause consumption suppress FD use, and can joint selection restore it?
evaluation_items.encoding: Top: MCV-to-residual-clause-state-to-FD diagram. Bottom: compact Census and DMV all/independent versus joint/selected consumption comparison.
evaluation_items.caption: MCV executes first and changes the clause state visible to FD. Census mixed selection restores FD reachability; corrected DMV supplies all-statistics suppression and a fixed physical state from a diagnostic optimization whose maintenance-cost interpretation is retired.

evaluation_items.title: Physical deployment and fresh native validation
evaluation_items.takeaway: Both physical states match fresh native CE; the DMV state's diagnostic optimization and budget interpretation are retired, and only its fixed-state semantic fidelity is used.
